snippet.title: Go Slimey Go! Release Trailer
snippet.description:
It's finally here, I worked hard on the sountrack (and sound effects!) for Game Slimey Go!

You can play the demo for free on Steam or Itch.io, give it a try, and if you like it please consider buying it! It'll help us continue making games ♥

Find more about the game here: https://linktr.ee/goslimeygo
